app_name.description: Brand name; identical in all locales

btn_screenshot.description: Home entry button: captures the visible area of the active tab

btn_screenshot_sub.message: Grab the visible area of the current tab

btn_upload.description: Home entry button: pick a local image file

btn_clipboard.description: Home wide button: read clipboard image

input_hint.message: Paste with Ctrl+V · or drag an image into this window
input_hint.description: Hint line under the three entries

crop_hint.message: Drag on the preview to select a QR area (optional — the full image is scanned by default)

btn_scan_full.description: Crop view action: scan the whole image

btn_scan_crop.description: Crop view action: scan the selected rectangle

err_no_qr_title.description: Error title when nothing was decoded

err_no_qr_hint.message: Try selecting the QR area, or use a clearer image
err_no_qr_hint.description: Error hint suggesting crop retry or a better image

err_capture_title.description: Error title when captureVisibleTab is rejected

err_capture_hint.message: This page may not allow screenshots. Take a system screenshot (e.g. Win+Shift+S), then paste or upload it
err_capture_hint.description: Guidance when a page cannot be captured

err_clipboard_no_image.description: Error title when clipboard holds no image

err_clipboard_read.description: Error title when clipboard read() rejects

err_clipboard_read_hint.message: Click inside this popup first and retry, or just press Ctrl+V

err_fetch_image.message: Failed to fetch the image (possibly blocked by CORS or the network)
err_fetch_image.description: Error title when a remote image fetch fails (context-menu flow)

btn_retry_crop.description: Error view button: re-enter crop with the same image

btn_open.description: Result card action: open http/https link in a new tab

btn_copy.description: Result card action: copy text to clipboard

btn_keep.description: Result card action: save to history (visible when history is on)

copied.description: Button flash feedback after a successful copy

copy_failed.description: Button flash feedback after a failed copy

kept.description: Button flash feedback after keeping a result

text_label.description: Result meta label for non-URL payloads

history_off.message: History is off. Turn it on to keep scan results

history_clear_confirm.description: History panel: armed state of the two-step confirm

history_delete.description: History row action: remove one entry

badge_fail.description: Toolbar badge on failure; symbol is locale-neutral

locale_lang.description: Internal: BCP47 tag of the actually matched locale; used to set <html lang> (more accurate than getUILanguage when fallback hit)

manifest_description.message: Capture, upload, or paste an image to decode QR codes locally and open web links

command_scan_description.message: Capture the current page and scan it for QR codes
